quotations.old_english: Ðá onféng he him and æt fulluhtbæþe nam æt ðæs B' handa him to godsuna
quotations.english: then he accepted him and took him from the font at the bishop's hand as his godson

quotations.old_english: Hiora wæs óðer his godsunu óðer Æþerédes ealdormonnes
quotations.english: one of them was his godson, the other was alderman Ethelred's

source_text: god-sunu, a; m. A GODSON :-- Ðá onféng he him and æt fulluhtbæþe nam æt ðæs B' handa him to godsuna then he accepted him and took him from the font at the bishop's hand as his godson, Bd. 3, 7; S. 529, 18. Hiora wæs óðer his godsunu óðer Æþerédes ealdormonnes one of them was his godson, the other was alderman Ethelred's, Chr. 894 ; Erl. 91, 29: L. In. 76; Th. i. 150, 13.
